attribution.note: Marcus explicitly reaffirms his own prediction about generative AI reliability.

semantics.note: The categorical prediction preserves the technology scope and indefinite horizon. The rhetorical question reaffirms the prediction without hedging it.

contract.note: Practical reliance in ordinary factual and professional work is a fair plain reading of trust in this context. The contract reasonably distinguishes task-appropriate reliability from perfection, while acknowledging the unstated verification standard.

evidence.note: Timely peer-reviewed research documents persistent errors and possible mitigations. Its restricted theoretical findings do not establish permanent practical unreliability.
Published before the cutoff, reporting February 2025 tests. Zero hallucinations on 70 prompts with low recall does not meet the breadth, useful coverage or independent replication requirements.

Timely original measurements document fabricated citations under bounded conditions without web access. The publisher's commercial interest warrants caution; these results establish neither permanent impossibility nor broad practical reliability.

reviews.rationale: No deadline was supplied and neither early-resolution condition is met. Continuing errors cannot prove permanent inability to achieve practical reliability. The narrow zero-hallucination result lacks the coverage, breadth and replication needed to contradict the forecast under the fair plain reading.
